title: Global model mappings
description: Provider mappings take priority and stop after one match. Otherwise, global rules run in order and keep mapping each result until no rule matches.
previewDescription: Preview the current draft for a provider, including its own mappings.
exclusionsHint: Applies to all providers, including future providers, except those selected here.

stopReasons.provider_rule: Provider rule matched; global rules skipped.
stopReasons.unchanged: The matched rule leaves the model unchanged.
stopReasons.cycle: Cycle detected; kept the last safe model.
stopReasons.step_limit: Mapping step limit reached; kept the last safe model.
stopReasons.model_length_limit: Model length limit reached; kept the last safe model.
